_comment: Paths a spec's §4.1 table names that were deliberately never created, for a spec
that is genuinely done. Every entry names a reason and the record that explains it.
scripts/audit_spec_status.py fails on an entry with no reason, on a waived path that
now exists, and on one the spec does not actually list — so this file cannot quietly
become the place inconvenient findings go.

GRVX-710.reason: SD-001: the spec's premise was wrong. It was written to remove five plan gates; exhaustive grep found one real gate and four features that were never gated. The freed capabilities are tested where they live, and a file named for five gates that did not exist would have been named after a thing that never happened.

GRVX-806.reason: The cardinality budget in pkg/evolve/cardinality.go is tested from pkg/evolve/evolve_test.go, which holds the package at 93.9% coverage. Splitting the file to match a table would move tests without adding one.
